text: Regulatory keywords that are ceremonial rather than substantive (an audit trail with no real downstream review) should not inflate governance_risk.
High automation coverage with concentrated rework signals brittle automation; discount the modelled financial_return rather than trusting the coverage figure.
Integration counts often include orchestration plumbing that is not real coupling; do not over-penalise change_enablement for it.
A regulated function in a regulated industry is more strategic than the base rubric allows; weight strategic_alignment up.
A concrete, numeric KPI paired with a named executive owner on a value function is a stronger commitment signal than the base rubric scores.
